name: HED soft edges (ControlNet 1.1)
plain: HED edges (Xie and Tu, ICCV 2015; ControlNet's Apache-2.0 re-implementation): soft, thick edge maps of a photo at several scales, the input of the soft-edge ControlNet. Apache-2.0 code and weights.
summary: Soft edge preprocessor of ControlNet 1.1 (controlnet_aux `HEDdetector`, ComfyUI's "HED Soft-Edge Lines"): lllyasviel's Apache-2.0 re-implementation of holistically-nested edge detection, a VGG-style network whose five side outputs are averaged into a soft edge map (RGB input, smoother edges than the original HED).

papers.title: Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models

no_kernels_reason: a VGG-style CNN: cuDNN convolutions are the whole time; no custom kernel measured to pay off
task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: a line / edge map `[H, W]` in [0, 1] at the input size (1 = line), the ControlNet preprocessors (line art, HED, PiDiNet, TEED / Anyline); M-LSD also returns straight line segments.

variants.name: hed

licence.training_note: Not stated for these checkpoints (lllyasviel/Annotators, ControlNet 1.1); HED (Xie and Tu) trains on BSDS500; this re-trained model states no data.

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
